notes.title: 🌟 "Control Evolution: Masterful Moves & Tactical Triumphs" 🎮💥
notes.notes:
🌟 GAME RELEASE UPDATE - Unleash New Moves and Masterful Tactics! 🎮💥

Hold onto your controllers, gamers! We've cooked up a sizzling update that's going to completely transform your gameplay! Get ready to dive into a world of revamped controls and tactical genius that will take your gaming skills to the next level! 🕹️🔥

⬆️⬇️ Z-Axis Movement with Keyboard Controls: Elevate your gaming experience to new heights! Our keyboard controls just got an upgrade, introducing Z-axis movement that lets you explore the game in a whole new dimension! Maneuver with unprecedented freedom! Conquer challenges and outmaneuver your rivals with these groundbreaking moves! 🚀🔼🔽

🎮🛡️ Added Blocking via Left Bumper on Gamepad: Brace yourselves for a game-changing tactic! The gamepad's left bumper is now your key to defense! With this added blocking feature, you'll master the art of defense and strategic play. Time your moves perfectly, block incoming attacks, and emerge victorious with your cunning maneuvers! 🛡️💪

🎵🔇 Need to strategize in silence? Activate stealth mode by muting the background music through the 9 keypad menu! Focus entirely on your game and dominate with these epic new controls! 🎶🔇

It's time to rewrite the rules, refine your strategies, and conquer the game in ways you never thought possible! Update now and be the first to experience these game-altering enhancements! 🌟🎮 #TacticalGenius #LevelUpYourPlay #GameRevolution 🚀🎉

notes.title: Update notes for 03Jan2024
notes.notes:
Resolved the issue with keyboard controls, enabling movement in the z-direction.
Implemented 'block' input functionality to the left bumper on the gamepad.
Note: Disabling background music is possible by clicking on the nine-key menu.
